In [[3962 BBY]], a '''battle''' was fought in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Zel system]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]], who had invaded Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and sparked the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The battle took place as a part of [[Mandalorian Triumph]], a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] campaign to capture the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. One prong of this advance took the Mandalorian forces from their territory [[Battle of the Ambria system|through]] the [[Ambria system/Legends|Ambria system]] and to Zel. The Mandalorians were victorious in the Zel [[Star system/Legends|system]],<ref name="Atlas" /> from which they moved on to another [[Battle of Commenor (Mandalorian Wars)|victory]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]]<ref name="Warfare" /> and continued to press Coreward.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Zel system was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Atlas" />
